name: app-shater-craftsman-key-needs-slide-with-blue-headwrap-portrait
title: Shater 'Client' persona key needs slide with a man in a keffiyeh and two Arabic phone screens
whatItIs: A pale blue slide with 'Key Needs' and 'العميل — صاحب الاحتياج' (The Client — the one with the need), five pill bullets about pricing clarity, trust and payment safety, a large faded 'Shater' wordmark, a smiling man in a red-and-white keffiyeh, and two phone screens showing service details and craftsman search.
whatItMeans: Empathetic and specific; naming exact worries like payment safety justifies later features like the wallet.
techniques: List concrete worries as the persona's key needs.
Fade the product wordmark behind the persona photo.
Match phone screens to the stated needs.

vocabulary.definition: The specific problems a persona needs solved.
A design element that reduces a user's uncertainty.
